> Governance committees providing expert review, decision-making authority, and advisory support for enterprise architecture artifacts, standards, and sales opportunities.

[governance/committees/README.md#committee-overview]

## Committee Overview

Governance committees provide specialized expertise for key enterprise architecture functions. Decision-making committees have consensus-based approval authority, while advisory committees provide recommendations to support business objectives. Committees ensure:

- Quality review and approval of ADRs and standards
- Technical guidance for sales opportunities
- Cross-domain impact analysis and coordination
- Alignment with enterprise architecture principles
- Consistency in documentation across domains
- Best practices development and knowledge sharing
page_texts.3:
[governance/committees/README.md#-decision-making-committees]

## 📋 Decision-Making Committees

The following committees have decision-making authority for enterprise architecture artifacts:
page_texts.4:
[governance/committees/README.md#-adr-review-committeeadr-review-committeemd]

### 📋 [ADR Review Committee](./adr-review-committee.md)

Reviews and approves Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) across all domains, ensuring technical quality, governance compliance, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards. The committee has decision-making authority through consensus.
page_texts.5:
[governance/committees/README.md#-standards-review-committeestandards-review-committeemd]

### 📐 [Standards Review Committee](./standards-review-committee.md)

Reviews and approves Enterprise Architecture Standards across all domains, ensuring technical quality, governance compliance, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles. The committee has decision-making authority through consensus.
page_texts.6:
[governance/committees/README.md#-technology-review-committeetechnology-review-committeemd]

### 🔧 [Technology Review Committee](./technology-review-committee.md)

Evaluates and recommends technology platforms, tools, and solutions for enterprise adoption, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, strategic direction, and organizational capabilities. The committee has decision-making authority through consensus.
page_texts.7:
[governance/committees/README.md#-advisory-committees]

## 💼 Advisory Committees

The following committees provide expert guidance and recommendations:
page_texts.8:
[governance/committees/README.md#-sales-review-committeesales-review-committeemd]

### 🤝 [Sales Review Committee](./sales-review-committee.md)

Provides technical review and architectural guidance for sales opportunities, ensuring proposed solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, capabilities, and strategic direction. The committee provides advisory recommendations to sales teams and leadership.
